questions.prompt: Which statement about converting lambdas to function pointers is true?
options: Any lambda converts to a matching function pointer
Only capture-less lambdas convert implicitly to a function pointer
No lambda converts; you must use std::function
questions.explanation: A lambda with no captures has no state, so the compiler gives it a conversion to `R(*)(Args...)`. That's how you pass one to a C API like `qsort` or a C driver callback. Once it captures anything, it needs an object, so you use a template parameter or `std::function` instead.
